title: Hundreds, tens and ones in 345
examples: What is the value of 4 in 345?
How do I read a 3-digit number?

explain.say: If you had 345 marbles, counting them one by one would take ages! Look at the board: big flat squares, long rods and tiny cubes. Together they show 345 in a flash.
Now look! Here it is in 3D: base-ten blocks. Can you see the thousand and the hundreds? Tap any part, and I will tell you about it.
Here is one flat square. It is 10 rods side by side, so it holds 100 small cubes. We call it a hundred. How many rods make one flat?
See the 3 flats? That is 3 hundreds, or 300. The 3 in 345 sits in the hundreds place, so it means 300, not just 3. Can you count the flats with me?
Now add 4 rods, that is 40, and 5 small cubes, that is 5. So 345 is 300 and 40 and 5. Which part is worth the most?
Amazing! Now look: the same digits in a new order make 543. Now the 5 is worth 500! Where a digit sits decides its value. Challenge: what is the smallest number you can make with 3, 4 and 5?

faq.a: Place value means a digit is worth more or less depending on where it sits. In 345, the 3 is in the hundreds place, so it is worth 300.

faq.q: What is the value of 4 in 345?
faq.a: The 4 is in the tens place, so it is worth 4 tens, which is 40.
The tens digit is 4. But if you count every ten inside 345, including the ones packed in the hundreds, there are 34 tens.

faq.q: How do I read a 3-digit number?
faq.a: Say the hundreds, then the rest as a two-digit number. 345 is three hundred and forty-five, or three hundred forty-five in American English.

faq.q: What does a zero do in a number like 305?
faq.a: Zero holds a place. It shows there are no tens, so the 3 stays in the hundreds place. Without it, 305 would become 35.
asks: Why do we need zero in 305?

facts: One hundred is 10 tens, and one ten is 10 ones.
Place value with zero as a placeholder was developed in India and spread to the world through Arabic scholars.

quiz.say: What is the value of the 7 in 472?
quiz.show: What is the value of the 7 in 472?
quiz.why: The 7 is in the tens place, so it is 7 tens, which is 70.

wrong.0: 7 would be its value in the ones place.
wrong.1: 700 would be its value in the hundreds place.

quiz.say: Which number is 2 hundreds, 0 tens and 6 ones?
quiz.show: Which number is 2 hundreds, 0 tens and 6 ones?
quiz.why: 2 hundreds is 200, there are no tens, and 6 ones: 206.

wrong.1: 26 leaves out the zero, so the 2 shrinks to 2 tens.
wrong.2: 260 has 6 tens and 0 ones, the wrong way round.
